posts.title: After a Decade in the City, I am Moving Out of San Francisco
posts.description: Back in 2011, I moved to San Francisco to attend San Francisco State University and gain some life experience in a big city. After all these years here, San Francisco became such a huge part of my identity, that I consider it to be where I’m “from” even more than the two towns I grew up in.
